children: Cheng Chi Fung, a director serving as Chief Technology Officer, sold 3,790 ordinary shares at $170.00 per share on September 4, 2026. The total sale amount reported was $644,300. Following the transaction, Cheng Chi Fung directly owns 136,568 ordinary shares and indirectly owns 5,772,397 ordinary shares through the Cheng Huang Family Trust. The footnote states the trust is the Cheng Huang Family Trust U/T/A DTD 12/22/2003, of which the reporting person and his spouse are trustees and the reporting person, his spouse and their children are beneficiaries, and the reporting person disclaims beneficial ownership except to the extent of his and his spouse's pecuniary interest therein.
